{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the count of -999 in biomarker_baseline
count_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {count_neg999}')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
num_duplicates = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {num_duplicates}')

# Check how many patients were re-tested (i.e., have sample_seq > 1)
retested_patients = data[data['sample_seq'] > 1]['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {retested_patients}')"}
